_notes: Data only. Non-usable dressing. Each entry is one mesh, or an instanced scatter when count > 1 (seeded, deterministic). A `portal` entry is a flat opening that shows the named place live; it faces along `normal` when given, else toward the spot named in `face` and has size [width, height]. `when` shows an entry only while an object is in a state. at = [spot, yaw, pitch, distance]; pos = absolute.
